description: This file contains shell functions for managing boot device switching and firmware upgrades on GL.iNet devices, including setting the next boot partition and performing NAND/NOR firmware upgrades.

methods.name: glinet_using_boot_dev_switch
methods.description: Checks whether the device is using a boot device switch setting.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nand
methods.description: Sets the device to boot from NAND on next restart.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nor
methods.description: Sets the device to boot from NOR on next restart.

methods.name: glinet_nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs an upgrade that involves switching between NAND and NOR flash.

methods.name: nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the actual firmware upgrade, determining whether it's a NAND or NOR upgrade based on the upgrade file.
